before.title: 金額's／時間's + worth of sth
before.content: 價值若干金額的某事物／需花費若干時間的某事物。若金額為阿拉伯數字，則不加「s」。

after.content: 表示值若干金額或相當於若干時間的數量。可用 six dollars' worth of…、a week's worth of…；教材另列 $1,000 worth of… 的數字符號寫法。原稿省略撇號的說明只對其示例，不擴張成所有數字所有格的禁則；時間長短與單複數仍須依實際詞組判斷。

facts.reason: Correct the copied s/apostrophe ambiguity using the viewed printed example and direct dictionary worth constructions, while retaining immutable title and source transcription.

before.title: as be one's custom
before.content: 是某人的習慣。依原書字樣抄錄。

after.content: 是某人的習慣。標題保留教材的 be 原形標記；完整句子須依主詞與時態使用 as is／was one's custom，例如 as was her custom。

before.title: A and B alike = both A and B

after.content: A 和 B 兩者都……；對 A 和 B 同樣地。alike 在此強調兩者皆然，依完整句意翻譯。

facts.reason: Make the both/equally scope visible; this is a precision improvement, not a claim that bare A and B is always incorrect.
